text: On a snowy morning in the small town of Pontypool, Ontario, shock jock Grant Mazzy meets a woman at his car window who repeats his words. At the radio station, calls come in of a riot and of [crowds trying to eat one another|images|blood], and a French broadcast warns listeners not to use the English language. Locked in the booth with his producer and a doctor, Grant learns that the sickness [travels inside certain words|rules|it passes to others], and that [every sentence he speaks on air|trigger|seeing or hearing too much] may carry it further.
